panel.no_reply: No reply from the bot: press the button again
choice.no_such_button: That button does not match any option.
pile.where.shuffle: into your deck and shuffle it
pile.where.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
pile.instruction: {card}: take {how} out of your discard pile{kind}, put it {where} and press [[btn.done]]. I detect which one you moved.
pile.instruction_many: {card}: take {how} out of your discard pile{kind}, put them {where} and press [[btn.done]]. I detect which ones you moved.
pile.status: Move the card from your discard pile to your deck and press [[btn.done]]
pile.unreadable: I could not read your discard pile: press [[btn.done]] again.
pile.wrong: {titles} cannot be chosen with {card}: put it back in your discard pile and press [[btn.done]].
pile.too_many: You took {n} cards out of the discard pile ({titles}) and you may take only {max}. Put the extra ones back and press [[btn.done]].
pile.none: I do not see that you took any card out of your discard pile: take it, put it in your deck and press [[btn.done]].
pile.too_few: I only see {n} card(s) out of the discard pile and you have to move {min}.
rage.instruction: {card}: put in your discard pile the defense or versatile cards you want to give up (+{per} to the value for each one) and press [[btn.done]]. If you give up none, just press [[btn.done]]. I detect which ones you put.
rage.status: Put the cards to give up in your discard pile and press [[btn.done]]
rage.wrong: {items} cannot be given up for {card}: only defense and versatile cards count. Take them back to your hand and press [[btn.done]] again.
moves.where.adjacent: on a free space next to {who}
moves.where.nearest: on the free space nearest to {who}
moves.optional: (or press [[btn.skip]] if you prefer to leave it where it is)
moves.status.move: Move {name} on the table and press [[btn.done]]
moves.status.place: Place {name} on the table and press [[btn.done]]
moves.occupied: That space is occupied by {holder} ({spot}): move {name} to a free one.
moves.must_end: {name} has to end up {where}; it is now at {spot}.
moves.too_short: {name} moved {squares}; it has to move exactly {steps}.
moves.no_path: From where it was, {name} cannot reach that space in {squares} without passing through enemy fighters (this card does not allow it): find another path or another space.
moves.also_moved: {other} was also moved: put it back in its place ({spot}) and press [[btn.done]].
moves.not_found: I cannot find the miniature of {name} on the table.
moves.off_board: {name} is off the board ({dist} from the nearest space): put it on a space and press [[btn.done]].
hidden.start: You lost the combat with a card that lets you look at the bot's hand and choose {cards} for it to discard. Take it out of the green hand zone (Green) yourself to see it; put the chosen card face up on the bot's discard pile, put the rest back in its hand and press [[btn.done]].
hidden.status: Discard 1 bot card by hand, put the rest back and press [[btn.done]]
hidden.foreign: That card is not from the bot's hand: its discard pile holds a card that is not its own ({titles}). Remove it and press [[btn.done]].
hidden.extra_in_hand: The bot's hand holds cards that do not belong to it: {titles}. Remove them and press [[btn.done]].
hidden.too_many: You discarded {n} cards; you may discard only 1 ({titles}). Put the extra ones back and press [[btn.done]].
hidden.missing: Cards are missing from the bot's hand: put {titles} back in its hand (Green zone) and press [[btn.done]].
hidden.nothing_yet: You have not discarded any card yet: put the chosen one face up on the bot's discard pile and press [[btn.done]].
hidden.unseen: {titles} is on the discard pile but was not in the bot's hand: remove it and press [[btn.done]].
hidden.discards: The bot discards {card} (the one you chose).
hidden.keeps_wildfire: The bot keeps {card} (Wildfire returns it to its hand).
hidden.empty_hand: You look at the bot's hand: it has no cards in hand.
hidden.not_visible: You look at the bot's hand, but I cannot see its cards on the table: ask it to show them.
hidden.row_pick: The bot puts its hand face up ({n} cards) and pings: choose one with a ping (Tab) on the card or with its panel button.
hidden.row_reveal: The bot puts its hand face up ({n} cards) and pings: you only look. Press [[panel.end_action]] or [[panel.cancel]] and it picks it up.
hidden.row_failed.pick: I could not put the bot's hand on the table: its cards are in the chat, choose with the panel buttons.
hidden.row_failed.reveal: I could not put the bot's hand on the table: its cards are in the chat.
hidden.row_failed.grant: I could not take the cards out of the bot's hand; repeat [[panel.look]].
hidden.look_status.pick: Bot's hand in view: Tab on the card you choose, or its button
hidden.look_status.reveal: Bot's hand in view: End action or [[panel.cancel]] puts it away
hidden.look_status.grant: Bot's hand in view: Tab on the card to discard, or [[panel.cancel]]
hidden.resume.pick: The bot's hand is still in view: choose a card with a ping (Tab) or with its panel button.
hidden.resume.reveal: The bot's hand is still in view (look only): press [[panel.end_action]] or [[panel.cancel]] and it picks it up.
hidden.resume.grant: The bot's hand is still in view: ping (Tab) the card to discard or press [[panel.cancel]].
hidden.ping_reveal: This time you only look: press [[panel.end_action]] or [[panel.cancel]] and the bot picks up its hand.
hidden.ping_not_now: That card cannot be chosen now.
hidden.close.discard_row: The bot discards {card} and puts the rest back in its hand.
hidden.close.discard_hand: The bot discards {card} (it was still in its hand) and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.deck_row: {card} goes on top of the bot's deck; the rest goes back to its hand.
hidden.close.deck_hand: {card} goes on top of the bot's deck: it was still in its hand, put it on top of its deck yourself; the bot picks up its hand.
hidden.close.wildfire_kept: The bot keeps {card} (Wildfire returns it) and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.kept_hits: The bot keeps {card} and {hits} and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.discard_bounce: The bot discards {card} (Wildfire returns it to its hand) and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.kept: The bot keeps {card} and picks up its hand.
hidden.close.collect: The bot picks up its hand.
hidden.fail.not_in_row: that card was not in the row on the table
hidden.fail.not_in_discard: {card} is not yet visible on the bot's discard pile
hidden.fail.where_discard: and put {card} on its discard pile
hidden.fail.where_deck: and put {card} on top of its deck
hidden.fail.row: The table did not close the bot's row ({fail}): put its cards back in its hand{where}; press [[panel.end_action]] to sync.
hidden.ask_prediction: {card}: predict the printed value of the bot's card (you play it face up) or play it face down, with the panel buttons. The bot chooses its defense afterwards.
hidden.face_down: You play the card face down: no prediction.
hidden.predicted: You predict the bot's card has printed value {value}: your card is played face up.
hidden.intuition_notice: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} has an active token: it spends it, draws 1 card and your attack is played face up. Put your card face down as usual and press [[panel.reveal]]: I turn it and the bot chooses its defense seeing it.
hidden.intuition_face_up: UNCANNY INTUITION: your attack is played face up: {card} (value {value}); the bot chooses its defense seeing it.
hidden.bot_predicts: The bot plays {card} face up and predicts that the printed value of your card is {n}.
hidden.bot_intuition: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} has an active token: you spend one, draw 1 card (I deal it to you) and the bot's attack is played face up: {card} (value {value}).
fx.no_spot: There is no human_ongoing_spot in the configuration: I recognize your ONGOING in your discard pile. Configure the ONGOING zones and calibrate them with --read-only.
fx.not_ongoing: {title} is not an ONGOING: I do not count it in your ONGOING zone. Move it to your discard pile and press [[panel.end_action]].
fx.detected: I detect {title}: the card asks you for a choice.
fx.no_actions: {title}: you do not gain its actions (an effect in play prevents it), you have {left} left.
fx.replaces: and replaces {title} (only one ONGOING per player)
fx.where_discard: in plain sight in your discard pile
fx.in_play: {title} stays in play{replaced}: leave it {where}, I keep it in mind until it expires.
fx.mandatory: This choice is mandatory (the card is already played): choose one of the panel options.
fx.cancelled: Choice cancelled: it resolves without doing anything.
fx.ability.detective_draw: OCCULT DETECTIVE: you are on the rival's start space: you may draw 2 cards (or none); choose on the panel and I deal them to you.
fx.ability.anung_discard_move: ANUNG UN RAMA: discard 1 card (mandatory) and move {hero} up to the BOOST of that card.
fx.ability.wildfire_start: WILDFIRE: discard the bottom card of your deck. If it is burning, 1 damage to another fighter in {hero}'s zone (use -1 on it; the burning card returns to your hand); if not, move {hero} up to 2 spaces.
fx.ability.team_tactics: TEAM TACTICS: you may move any fighter 1 space (yours or the rival's). Do it on the table, or skip it.
choice.no_draw_reason: an effect in play prevents you from drawing cards, so you do not draw
choice.prompt.optional: Do you want to do it?
choice.prompt.predict: Predict the printed value of the rival card, or play face down
choice.prompt.redirect: Does {to} take the damage ({amount}) instead of {fighter}?
choice.prompt.use_effect: Do you use the effect of {title}?
choice.prompt.ability.inventive: INVENTIVE: draw 2 cards instead of 1 and put a card from your hand at the bottom of your deck?
choice.prompt.shield: A card is about to look at your hand: reveal {shield} (only if you hold it) and cancel it?
choice.pick_between: Choose between {min} and {max} options and confirm.
choice.pick_max: You may choose only {max}: remove one first.
choice.restrict.attack: An effect in play prevents you from attacking now (for example, an attack as the first action of the turn): the attack buttons are hidden.
choice.restrict.draw: An effect in play prevents you from drawing cards (Cold Iron And Holy Water): the Maneuver only moves, {why}.
choice.restrict.gain_actions: An effect in play prevents you from gaining actions: schemes that give actions do not give them to you this turn.
choice.restrict.move: An effect in play prevents one of your miniatures from leaving its space: if you move it, I put it back.
ops.random_positions: {title}, at random: {which} of your hand counting from the left
narr.look_cancelled: reveals a card and cancels the look at its hand
narr.looks.human: you look at the bot's hand
narr.attack_face_up: the attack is played face up
narr.price.cannot_pay: the bot cannot pay (it lacks the cards to discard {cards}): it takes {stake} damage
narr.price.prefers: it prefers to take {stake} damage rather than lose {cards} cards
narr.price.no_change: it does not change the combat
narr.price.ignores: the bot {paid} to ignore the value of {title} (it becomes 0; {why})
narr.fighter.back: {fid} returns to the board at {spot} with {hp} HP
narr.from_deck.one: {n} card from the deck to {poss} hand
narr.from_deck.other: {n} cards from the deck to {poss} hand
narr.hand_to_deck: from the hand to the deck
narr.fstatus.cannot_leave_space: {fid} cannot leave its space this turn
narr.fstatus.immune_to_effect_damage: {fid} takes no effect damage this turn
narr.fstatus.attack_bonus: {fid} gets +{n} to its attacks this turn
narr.status.cannot_gain_actions.bot: does not gain actions this turn
narr.status.cannot_gain_actions.human: you do not gain actions this turn
narr.status.cannot_draw.bot: does not draw cards this turn
narr.status.cannot_draw.human: you do not draw cards this turn
narr.status.immune_to_effect_damage.bot: its fighters take no effect damage this turn
narr.status.immune_to_effect_damage.huma: your fighters take no effect damage this turn
narr.cancels_after: cancels the effects of {title} after combat
narr.cancels_after_rival: cancels the rival's effects after combat
tbl.where.zone_other: another space in the zone of {who}
tbl.where.zone_hero_other: another space in your hero's zone
tbl.where.nearest_hero: as close as possible to your hero
tbl.put: put {fid} on the board ({where}) with {hp} HP

play.reload_missing: TTS reloaded the game and objects from the configuration are missing: {missing}. I stop without touching the table; load the right game and resume with --resume.
play.reload_retry: TTS reloaded the game and does not answer yet ({error}); retrying.
play.reload_ok: TTS reloaded the game: GUIDs checked and panel recreated. Press [[panel.end_action]] so the bot rereads the table.
play.internal_error: Internal bot error; the game goes on. Repeat the button or use [[panel.cancel]].
sess.hero_uncoded: The bot plays {name}. Its ability ('{ability}') is not coded in the engine yet: the bot ignores it and plays by value and boost; if it affects you, apply it yourself on the table.
sess.resume.game_over: Game over: player {winner} wins. (Press [[panel.undo]] if it is a mistake.)
sess.resume.effect: There is a pending effect choice: {prompt}. Press one of the panel options.
sess.resume.table_gate: Do what your card says on the table and press [[panel.end_action]]: the other card's effect follows.

sess.resume.discard: There is a pending discard: finish it and press [[panel.end_action]].
sess.resume.ability: Your start-of-turn ability is still pending: {wait} Do it on the table and press [[panel.end_action]].
sess.resume.after: There is an action open: resolve it on the table and press [[panel.end_action]].
sess.resume.turn: It is your turn and you have {n} action(s) left.
sess.bot_retry_hint: Press [[panel.end_action]] so the bot resumes its turn.

sess.deal_yours: Draw your {n} starting cards (the bot does not deal to your seat).

setup.first.single: You go first. Draw your 5 cards, place {names} on your starting space ({zone}) and press [[btn.ready]]. The bot will place afterwards, looking at where you put it.
setup.first.several: You go first. Draw your 5 cards, place {names} on your starting space ({zone}) and press [[btn.ready]]. The bot will place afterwards, looking at where you put them.
setup.then.alone: Now draw your 5 cards and press [[btn.ready]].
setup.then.names: Now place {names} on your starting space ({zone}), draw your 5 cards and press [[btn.ready]].

err.mull_not_returned: the bot's cards have not gone back to the deck; retry with Ready
err.shuffle: I could not shuffle the bot's whole deck ({total} cards); retry with Ready
err.hand_mismatch: the bot's hand on the table ({table} cards) does not match the engine's ({engine}); retry with Ready
err.move_piece: I could not move {name}'s piece to space {space}
err.bot_pieces: the bot's pieces are not where they should be; retry with Ready
err.hero_not_at_start: {name} is not on its starting space; retry with Ready
setup.bot_places_hero: The bot places {name} (your hero) on its starting space ({zone}).

setup.mull.go.plain: Mulligan: put your hand back in your deck, shuffle and draw {n} cards again. Then press [[btn.ready]].
setup.missing_piece: {name} still has to be placed on your starting space ({zone}).
setup.draw_first: Draw your {n} cards before pressing Ready.
setup.mull_count: After your mulligan you must have {n} cards in hand (you have {count}).
sess.name_pieces_warn: Warning: I could not name the miniatures ({err}).
sess.tts_odd: TTS did not answer as expected ({err}); press the button again (End action if the bot was playing).
sess.tts_down: Table and connection error: I cannot talk to TTS ({err}); is it closed? It will be retried with the next button.
sess.setting_up: The game is still being set up: finish the placement and press [[btn.ready]].
sess.effect_pending: There is a pending effect choice: answer with one of the option buttons.
sess.table_first: First do what your card says on the table and press [[panel.end_action]]: the combat goes on afterwards.
sess.ability_first: Your start-of-turn ability first, on the table: {wait} Then press [[panel.end_action]].
sess.warn_project: Warning: I could not show a bot effect on the table ({err}).
sess.warn_check: Warning: I could not check a bot effect on the table ({err}).
err.effect_pending: there is already a pending effect choice
sess.choice_hint: {prompt}: press one of the panel options ({options}).{hint}
look.granted: {title} lets you look at the bot's hand: press [[panel.look]].
restart.arm: Restart game: press again within 3 seconds to confirm. All cards go back to their decks, life is restored, the pieces leave the board and the save is deleted.
restart.delete_fail: I could not delete the save {path}: {err}
restart.done: Game restarted: back to the deal, the mulligan and the placement.
err.no_dead_spot: dead_spot is missing from the configuration: there is nowhere to put the miniatures aside
restart.no_human_deck: Warning: without human_deck_guid I cannot put your cards back in your deck; do it yourself.
err.deck_incomplete: {side} deck was not left complete ({got} of {want} cards); repeat {button}
err.reset_dirty: the restart did not leave the table clean (hands, discard piles, pieces or dials); repeat {button}
err.reset_plan: invalid reply to the restart check: {got}
err.reset_gather: I cannot gather the {n} cards of {side} deck (I can reach {found}); I have moved nothing. Leave all its cards in the hand, the discard pile, the combat zone or the deck and repeat {button}
sess.warn_table_behind: Warning: the bot's table does not match the engine yet ({err}); it will be retried.
maneuver.no_draw: Maneuver: {reason}. Move your miniatures and press [[panel.end_action]].
maneuver.drew: Maneuver: you draw 1. Move your miniatures and press [[panel.end_action]].
maneuver.empty: Maneuver: your deck is empty, you do not draw. Move your miniatures (you may boost by discarding a card) and press [[panel.end_action]].
maneuver.dealt: Maneuver: I gave you 1 card. Move your miniatures (you may boost by discarding a card) and press [[panel.end_action]]
deal.maneuver_fail: I could not give you the Maneuver card ({err}). Draw your card by hand and press [[panel.end_action]].
deal.confirm_fail: I could not confirm the deal of your card ({err}): look at your hand; if you do not have the new card, draw by hand and press [[panel.end_action]].
deal.confirm_fail_short: I could not confirm the deal of your card: look at your hand. Draw your card by hand if you do not have the new one.
deal.card_fail: I could not give you the card. Draw your card by hand and press [[panel.end_action]].
deal.after_discard: When you have discarded and press [[panel.end_action]] I will give you {cards}.
deal.fail: I could not give you {cards}{why} ({err}). Draw {cards} by hand and press [[panel.end_action]].
deal.given_discard: I gave you {cards}{why}. What you have to discard is what you had before, not these.
deal.confirm_fail_n: I could not confirm the deal of {cards}{why} ({err}): look at your hand; if you are missing some, draw by hand and press [[panel.end_action]].
deal.short: I could not give you {short} of the {cards}{why}. Draw {short} by hand and press [[panel.end_action]].
deal.missing_one: The card I gave you did not reach your hand. Draw your card by hand.
deal.missing_n: The {n} cards I gave you did not reach your hand. Draw by hand.
maneuver.no_boost_value: {title} has no boost value: it does not count as a Maneuver boost.
hazard.hit: {name} crosses a hazard edge ({a}-{b}) and loses {dmg} HP: from {before:g} to {after:g}.
game.over_fix: Game over: player {winner} wins. If it was an HP mistake, fix it with +1 or press [[panel.undo]].

scheme.detect_discard: I detect {title}: applied, {gain}. Discarding your hand is up to you: they are your cards.
scheme.replaces: {title} replaces {old}: only one ONGOING is active per player.
scheme.detect_bonus: I detect {title}: +{bonus} to your combat cards until the start of your next turn (now +{total}). Moving up to 5 is up to you on the table; discard the scheme when your next turn starts.
scheme.detect_choose: I detect {title}: you have to choose {count} effects. To heal {hero} {heal:g}, press its +1 {times}; the deck is up to you on the table.
scheme.detect_gain: I detect {title}: {gain}; you resolve the rest: {text} Use +1 / -1 for HP.
scheme.detect_plain: I detect {title}: {text} Resolve it by hand; use +1 / -1 for HP.
scheme.no_fighter: {title} can only be played by {fighter}, who is not on the board: nothing happens. Take the card back to your hand if the table allows it.
gain.blocked: you do not gain the {n} actions (an effect in play prevents it), you have {left} left
gain.ok.one: you gain {n} action, you have {left} left
gain.ok.other: you gain {n} actions, you have {left} left
value.invalid: Invalid value: type a number between -100 and 100.
value.no_combat: There is no pending combat: the extra value only counts before Reveal, in the combat under way.
value.boost_read: The boost is read from your discard pile when you press [[panel.continue]]: there is no need to type a value.
sess.not_possible: Not possible now: finish the resolution under way (Reveal / End action) or wait for your turn.
sess.action_open: You already have an action open: resolve it on the table and press [[panel.end_action]] before starting another.
attack.open: There is already an attack open: put your attack card face down and press [[panel.reveal]] (or [[panel.cancel]]).
combat.bot_card_on_table: The bot's card is already on the table: press [[panel.reveal]].
attack.declared: {attacker} attacks {target}: put your attack card face down in your combat zone and press [[panel.reveal]].
attack.intuition_carry: UNCANNY INTUITION already applied to this attack (token spent and card drawn earlier).
cancel.flipped: The cards are already flipped: it cannot be cancelled. Press [[panel.continue]] (with your boost card in the discard pile) or [[panel.no_boost]].
cancel.bot_attack: A bot attack cannot be cancelled: reveal (with no card if you have no defense).
cancel.done: Attack cancelled: the action was not spent.
cancel.intuition_again: UNCANNY INTUITION was already applied to this attack: if {attacker} attacks {target} again no other token is spent and no card is drawn again.
cancel.discard: Pending discard cancelled: the table rules and it is synchronised at the next End action.
cancel.selection: Attacker selection and extra value cleared.
err.return_card: I could not put the bot's card back in its hand; repeat [[panel.cancel]]
err.card_not_back: the bot's card has not gone back to its hand; repeat [[panel.cancel]]
cancel.put_back: I could not put {title} back in the bot's hand: put it there yourself.
reveal.many: There are {n} of your cards face down in the zone: leave just one and press [[panel.reveal]].
reveal.face_up: Your {card} was already face up in the combat zone: read as it lies.
err.no_card_down: none of your cards is face down in the combat zone
reveal.illegal: Illegal card: {err}. Change it or flip it and press [[panel.reveal]] again.
reveal.feint: {bot} cancels the effects of {card}: there is no boost to play.
reveal.boost_cancelled: {bot} takes the boost of {card} away (its effects are cancelled): no boost to play, the combat is resolved.

boost.prompt: The cards are already revealed: put your boost card in the discard pile and press [[panel.continue]], or press [[panel.no_boost]].

boost.many_new_max: There are {n} new cards in your discard pile ({titles}): this card takes at most {max} boosts, leave only those and press [[panel.continue]].

boost.no_value: {title} has no boost value: it does not count. Take that card out of the discard pile and put another with a boost value, or press [[panel.no_boost]].
cancel.stuck: Combat cancelled: the action was not spent. Pick up your card from the combat zone.
combat.cant_resolve: The combat cannot be resolved: {err}. Fix the table and press [[panel.continue]] or [[panel.no_boost]] again, or press [[panel.cancel]] to undo it.
reveal.illegal_fix: Illegal card: {err}. Change it and press [[panel.reveal]] again.
combat.table_gate: Do what your card says on the table and press [[panel.end_action]]: then {next} is resolved.
cfg.range.zoom: card_zoom_seconds: between 0 and {seconds:g}; card_zoom_scale: between 0 and {scale:g}
combat.after: Resolve the effects after the combat (move pieces, discard) and press [[panel.end_action]].
destiny.anung: Hellboy becomes ANUNG UN RAMA ({n} destinies, 6 or more): flip his miniature (it changes GUID, the bot already recognises it). His attacks add +2 and when your turn starts you discard 1 card and move up to its BOOST.

intuition.state: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} has {n} of {max} Intuition tokens active; the rest ({dark}) stay on the dark side.
intuition.turned_on: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} activates {tokens} ({n} of {max} active): I turned {tokens} to the active side and pinged the spot.
intuition.turned_off: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} spends {tokens} ({n} of {max} active): I turned {tokens} to the dark side and pinged the spot.
intuition.on_manual: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} activates {tokens} ({n} of {max} active): flip {tokens} of Intuition to the active side (green with yellow stripes) yourself ({why}).
intuition.off_manual: UNCANNY INTUITION: {name} spends {tokens} ({n} of {max} active): flip {tokens} of Intuition back to the dark side yourself ({why}).
intuition.why.nodata: I do not know the faces of those tokens
intuition.why.missing: I cannot find your Intuition tokens on the table
intuition.why.partial: I could not turn all of them
intuition.why.write_failed: the table did not take my write
intuition.reset: UNCANNY INTUITION: new game, so I turned {tokens} left active by the last one back to the dark side.
intuition.mismatch: {name}: the table shows {table} active Intuition token(s) and I counted {engine}: I trust my count, check them.
dials.touched: I am not touching {items}: it looks changed by hand. {advice}
dials.advice: Set {label} to {want} if the engine is right; use +1/-1 if the dial is right.
dials.update_fail: I could not update the life dials ({err}); fix them by hand.
dials.check_fail: I could not check the life dials: {bad}. Fix them by hand.
dials.paused: Bot turn paused: set the dials listed above by hand and press [[panel.end_action]] so it goes on.
dials.warn: Warning: {name}'s dial shows {value:g} and the engine {hp:g}: adjust with +1 / -1 or fix the dial.
unflip.fail: I could not hide a card again: flip it face down by hand.
end.finish_boost: Finish the boost first: press [[panel.continue]] or [[panel.no_boost]].
end.reveal_first: Reveal the combat under way first.
game.ended: The game is over (Undo game over if it is an HP mistake).
end.no_scheme: I saw no new scheme card in your discard pile: resolve the scheme by hand.
combat.gone: Combat cancelled: {name} is no longer in play. The action was not spent.
revive.place: Place {name} on {where} (it is not on the board).
revive.cannot: I cannot bring {name} back: its miniature is not on the board. Place it and repeat.
undo.none: There is no game over to undo.
undo.done: Game reopened: fallen heroes come back with 1 HP. Fix the HP with +1 / -1.
discard.hand_fail: I could not discard your hand ({failure}): discard it by hand.
discard.hand_done.one: I discard your hand ({n} card) for {reason}.
discard.hand_done.other: I discard your hand ({n} cards) for {reason}.
wildfire.hint: Wildfire: leave the burning card in your discard pile, press [[panel.end_action]] and then pick it up again (that way it is counted and the bot knows which one goes back to your hand).
discard.not_seen: I do not see {titles} in your discard pile yet: put it there and press [[panel.end_action]].
wildfire.assumed: Wildfire: I take the discard as done (burning cards go back to your hand).
wildfire.ask: I do not see the discard on the table yet. If you discarded burning cards that went back to your hand, press [[panel.end_action]] again and I will take it as done.
discard.missing: You still have to discard {n} card(s); take the cards already played to the discard pile too.
turn.look_first: Before ending the turn you can look at the bot's hand (Look at bot's hand); press [[panel.end_action]] to finish.
discard.limit: Discard {n} card(s) down to {limit} and press [[panel.end_action]] ([[panel.cancel]] cancels the discard).
turn.bot: End of your turn. Bot's turn.
wildfire.not_found: I cannot find {title} in the bot's deck to show it: I go on without a scene.
wildfire.show_fail: I could not show the Wildfire card ({err}); I go on with the turn.
wildfire.burning: It is a fire card: it goes back to {liz}'s hand
wildfire.moves.one: Not a fire card: {liz} moves {n} space
wildfire.moves.other: Not a fire card: {liz} moves {n} spaces
wildfire.stays: Not a fire card: {liz} stays where she is
anung.start: ANUNG UN RAMA: the bot discards {title} (BOOST {boost}) and moves {name} up to {boost}: {where}.
anung.start_still: ANUNG UN RAMA: the bot discards {title} (BOOST {boost}) and does not move {name}.
detective.start: OCCULT DETECTIVE: Hellboy starts the turn on your starting space; the bot draws {n}.
bot.exhaust: Empty deck: the bot draws and each of its fighters loses {damage} HP.
bot.card_down: The bot's {title} was already face down on the table: I count it as played. Press [[panel.reveal]].
dials.still_off: The dials still do not match the engine; I go on with the turn, check them.
medusa.gaze: Medusa's ability: 1 damage to {name} (HP from {before:g} to {after:g}).
attack.defend_now: Leave your defense face down (or nothing) and press [[panel.reveal]].
attack.bot_defend: The bot attacks {target} with {attacker}: leave your defense face down (or nothing) and press [[panel.reveal]].
scheme.expired: {label}: the +{n} to your combat cards expires. Discard the scheme.
turn.late: Your turn has started, but the bot's table does not match yet ({err}); it will be retried with your next button.
turn.ability_wait: {wait} Do it on the table and press [[panel.end_action]]: until then the other buttons wait.
err.identity: I cannot read the identity (images) of {side} deck: without it I touch no card
err.identity_reply: invalid answer to the identities reading: {got}
sess.tts_failed: TTS failed in {tag} ({err}); check the table by hand.
sess.panel_prep_fail: I could not prepare the panel state ({err}).
sess.table_update_fail: I could not update the table at the end ({err}).
sess.panel_update_fail: I could not update the panel after the checks ({err}).
err.snapshot: the table snapshot is not valid
st.setup_wait: Setup - place your sidekick, draw 5 and press [[btn.ready]]
st.setup_bot: Setup - the bot is preparing its table
st.ability: {head} - start-of-turn ability on the table, then End action
st.boost_stuck: {title} unresolved: fix the table; [[panel.continue]] or [[panel.no_boost]], or [[panel.cancel]]
st.boost_wait: {title} revealed: put a card in your discard and press [[panel.continue]] or [[panel.no_boost]]
st.wait.table: your card's effect on the table and [[panel.end_action]]
look.not_granted: No card lets you look at the bot's hand now.
look.already: The bot's hand is already in view.
look.when: You can only look at the bot's hand on your turn, during a combat or right after one.
look.unreflected: The bot's table has moves not shown yet: press [[panel.end_action]] (or [[panel.cancel]]) before looking at its hand.
look.empty: The bot has no cards in hand.
look.no_cards: I see no cards in the bot's hand on the table.
look.shown: Bot's hand ({n}): ping (Tab) the card to discard. You can also flip one face down and press [[panel.end_action]]; [[panel.cancel]] puts them back without discarding.
look.tts_unconfirmed: TTS did not confirm that it laid out the cards ({err}); check the table and press [[panel.cancel]] to pick them up.
look.partial: I could only lay out {n} of {total} cards; the rest stay in its hand.
look.none_shown: There are no bot cards in view: press [[panel.look]].
look.bad_ping: That ping was not on a card of the bot's row.
look.face_down: There are {n} cards face down in the row: leave exactly one (the one you discard) and press [[panel.end_action]], or ping (Tab) it.
look.discarded: The bot discards {title} and returns the rest of its hand.
look.returned: Bot's hand returned without discarding anything.
look.forced: Look closed by force ({why}): the table rules. Pick up by hand any bot cards that are not in its hand (the ones in the row) and put them back; press [[panel.end_action]] to synchronise.
look.why_stacked: no card of the row responds
look.fail_missing: that card was not in the row on the table
look.table_failed: The table did not make the change ({fail}): the bot's hand is still in view; repeat the ping or [[panel.cancel]].
look.not_in_discard: {title} is not yet visible in the bot's discard pile; if it does not arrive, press [[panel.end_action]].
err.unknown_card: unknown card in the bot's hand: {err}
adopt.table: I adopt what the table shows for the bot (hand, discard pile and positions). If a card is missing or extra, fix it on the table and press [[panel.end_action]].
adopt.discard: The table rules: {title} is in the bot's discard pile (because of an effect of the opponent); I count it as discarded.
adopt.stray: The bot's {title} was loose on the table: I put it back in its hand.
err.discard_missing: I did not find the bot's cards {ids} on the table to discard them
err.deck_dealt: the bot's deck dealt {dealt} of {n} cards. I looked for the deck {where}; if it is elsewhere, move it there or put the Scripting zone bot_deck_zone over it
err.table_mismatch: the bot's table does not match the engine (hand or discard pile); retry [[panel.end_action]]
err.move_guid: I could not move {name}'s piece ({guids}) to space {space}: the GUID does not exist on the table
bury.done_mine: {name} falls: I have moved it off the board.
bury.done_human: {name} falls: I have put it aside.
bury.failed_mine: {name} falls: remove its miniature from the table (I could not move it aside myself).
bury.failed_human: {name} (yours) falls: remove its miniature from the table.
revive.back: {name} is back in the game: I placed it on {where}.
revive.place_manual: Place {name} on {where} (I could not move it myself); then press [[panel.end_action]].
warn.missing: I cannot find {name}'s piece ({guid}) on the table; I keep its last space.
warn.off: {name} is off the board ({dist:.1f} from the nearest space, {zone}): if it died, press [[panel.remove]]; if not, put it back on the board.
warn.pinned: {name} cannot leave its place ({where}; effect in play): put it back, I keep it there.
warn.draw: Your hand has grown and an effect in play stops you from drawing ({reason}): put the card back in your deck. Meanwhile I count on it.
sess.save_fail: I could not save the game to {path}: {err}
err.card_not_in_hand: {title} is not in the bot's hand on the table; action cancelled
err.card_not_out: {title} did not leave the bot's hand (it is not on its card spot); action cancelled
bot.scheme_tail: puts {cards} from the discard pile at the bottom of its deck
bot.scheme_shuffle: shuffles {cards} from the discard pile into its deck
bot.return_hand: Put {cards} from your hand back in your deck and shuffle ({cause}; you choose them).
tr.draw_human: You draw {cards}{why}: do it on the table.
tr.discard_named: Put {titles} from your hand into your discard pile ({cause}) and press [[panel.end_action]].
tr.left_play: {title} leaves play ({cause}): it stays in your discard pile.
tr.left_play_hand: {title} leaves play ({cause}): move it from your ONGOING zone to your discard pile and press [[panel.end_action]].
tr.left_play_ping: {title} leaves play ({cause}): watch the ping, I will move it to your discard pile.
tr.moved.moves.done: {name} moves to {space}: I moved it myself (bot effect).
tr.moved.returns.done: {name} returns to the board at {space}: I moved it myself (bot effect).
tr.moved.moves.manual: {name} moves to {space} because of a bot effect: I could not move its miniature, move it yourself.
tr.moved.returns.manual: {name} returns to the board at {space} because of a bot effect: I could not move its miniature, move it yourself.
tr.where.you.shuffle: into your deck and shuffle it
tr.where.you.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
tr.where.bot.shuffle: into your deck and I shuffle it
tr.where.bot.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
tr.where.hand.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
tr.where.hand.shuffle: into your deck and shuffle it
tr.where.done.bottom: at the bottom of your deck
tr.bot_what.hand: from the bot's hand to its deck
tr.bot_what.bottom: from the bot's discard pile to the bottom of its deck
tr.bot_what.shuffled: from the bot's discard pile to its deck (shuffled)
tr.short: I could not move {titles} {what}: do it yourself.
tr.bot_puts_hand_bottom: The bot puts {cards} from its hand at the bottom of its deck.
tr.bot_puts_hand_shuffle: The bot puts {cards} from its hand into its deck and shuffles it.
tr.bot_puts_bottom: The bot puts {titles} from its discard pile at the bottom of its deck.
tr.bot_shuffles: The bot shuffles {titles} from its discard pile into its deck.
tr.gone: {titles} is no longer in your discard pile, so I assume it is already {where} ({cause}).
tr.cannot_touch_deck: I cannot touch your deck ({err}): put {titles} from your discard pile {where} yourself.
tr.return_bot_fail: I could not put {title} back in the bot's hand: put it there yourself.
tr.pickup: Pick up {titles} from your discard pile into your hand ({cause}).
tr.bot_recovers: The bot takes {title} from its discard pile back into its hand.
tr.not_loose: I cannot find {title} loose in the bot's discard pile: put it in its hand yourself.
tr.bot_takes: The bot takes {cards} from its deck.
tr.token_fail_add: I could not take a {name} token from the table: put an active one next to {hero} yourself.
tr.token_fail_remove: I could not remove the {name} token from {hero}: remove it yourself.
tr.token_missing: {hero} (bot) spends a {name} token that I do not see on the table: remove it yourself.
tr.form_human: {head}: change its miniature to that form yourself.
tr.form_both: {head}: I change its miniature and flip its ability token; ping on both.
tr.form_one: {head}: I change its miniature; ping on it.
tr.form_fail_mini: I could not change {name}'s miniature to {form}: change it yourself.
tr.form_fail_token: I could not flip {name}'s ability token: flip it yourself.
tr.ongoing_nospot: The bot leaves {title} in play (ONGOING); without bot_ongoing_spot in the configuration the card stays in its hand on the table.
tr.ongoing_fail: I could not put {title} in the bot's ONGOING zone: put it there yourself.
tr.ongoing_placed: The bot leaves {title} in play: it puts it face up in its ONGOING zone.
tr.tuck_human: Tuck {titles} under your hero card: it is no longer in your discard pile and its invention bonus holds for the rest of the game.
tr.tuck_bot: The bot tucks {titles} under its hero card: put it away from its discard pile (the bot's invention zone).
tr.tuck_placed: The bot tucks {titles} under its hero (invention): it lays it face up in its invention zone and the bonus holds for the rest of the game.
tr.tuck_fail: I could not put the bot's invention in its zone.
tr.remove_human: Take {titles} out of your discard pile and set it aside: it leaves the game.
tr.remove_bot: The bot removes {titles} from the game: set it aside from its discard pile.
tr.remove_placed: The bot removes {titles} from the game: it sets it aside face up.
tr.remove_fail: I could not set aside the cards the bot removes from the game.

board.unavailable: {name} is not supported yet: its map data did not pass verification. Supported maps: {maps}.

cli.config: JSON with GUIDs, zones, seats and positions
cli.read_only: only read the table and print a report
cli.seed: seed of the draw and the decks (default: random)
cli.ai: the bot's AI (overrides the ai key of the configuration; default heuristic)
cli.ai_time: search seconds per decision with --ai ismcts (1.5)
cli.resume: resume the game of the --state save; uses the saved language unless --language is given
cli.bot_pause: pause between the actions of the bot's turn and before your turn (overrides bot_pause of the configuration; default {default:g}; 0 turns it off)
cli.language: language of the panel and the chat (overrides language of the configuration; default es)

blind.status: Put the top cards of your deck you boost with in your discard and press [[btn.done]]

mists.move_old: Put {title}, the card that was discarded, from your combat spot in your discard pile.

strange.combat_to_bottom_bot: I put {cards} from your combat zone at the bottom of your deck ({cause}).
strange.combat_to_bottom_failed: I could not move {cards} to the bottom of your deck: put it there yourself, from your combat zone or your discard pile ({cause}).
strange.stack_top: Put {title} from your discard pile on top of your deck, face up ({cause}).
strange.stack_top_bot: I put {title} from your discard pile on top of your deck ({cause}).
strange.reveal: It reveals {cards} from its deck and plays {played}; the rest go to the bottom of its deck in random order ({cause}).
strange.reveal_none: It reveals {cards} from its deck and finds no attack or versatile card it can play: its attack has no card ({cause}).
choice.prompt.ability.dark_pact: DARK PACT: do you deal 1 damage to Doctor Strange to put the card you played at the bottom of your deck and draw 1 card?
choice.prompt.ability.bigfoot_draw: End of your turn, and no opposing fighter is in Bigfoot's zone: do you draw 1 card?
strange.hand_to_deck_bot: I shuffle your hand into your deck ({cause}).
strange.hand_to_deck_failed: Shuffle your hand into your deck and draw the cards the card gives you yourself: I do not deal them before your hand goes back ({cause}).
strange.hand_to_deck_failed_late: I could not put your hand into your deck: shuffle it into your deck and draw the cards the card gives you yourself ({cause}).
piece.resolved: {name}: the piece at {old} was {other}'s; I follow the one named {name} instead ({new}).
piece.unresolved: {name}: the piece at {guid} is {other}'s and I found {found} candidates by name; I keep the GUID, positions may be wrong.
piece.shared: The data gives GUID {guid} to {names}: if both are on the table I tell them apart by name; where I cannot, I say so and do not write that piece or dial.
dial.resolved: {name}'s life dial: the object at {old} is another dial's; I follow the one named {name} instead ({new}).
dial.unresolved: {name}'s life dial shares GUID {guid} with another dial and I found {found} candidates by name: I do not write or check it. Set that dial by hand to the life the panel shows.
narr.swapped.bot: returns to its hand and it plays {title} instead
narr.swapped.human: returns to your hand and you play {title} instead
sleight.instruction: {card}: take it back to your hand and put the card you play instead face up on your combat spot, then press [[btn.done]]. {attacker} must be able to play it (an attack or versatile card, and not another {card}). If you changed your mind, leave {card} where it is and press [[btn.done]].
sleight.status: Take it back to your hand, put the new card on your combat spot and press [[btn.done]]
sleight.same: {title} is another {card}: choose a different card. Take it back and press [[btn.done]] again.
sleight.counted: {card}: it goes back to your hand and you play {title} instead.
sleight.kept: {card}: you keep it and attack with it.
sleight.move_old: Take {title} from your combat spot back to your hand.
sleight.bot: {old}: the bot takes it back to its hand and puts {new} face up on its combat spot instead.
sleight.bot_manual: I could not do it on the table: take {old} from the bot's combat spot back to its hand and put {new} face up there instead.
sleight.missing: {card} is no longer on your combat spot and there is no new card there: put the card you play instead on your combat spot (or put {card} back) and press [[btn.done]] again.
prep.zone_created: The {role} discard zone was not on the table: I created it (GUID {guid}).
prep.zone_straightened: I straightened the {role} discard zone ({guid}): rotation 0, {rot:g}, 0.
prep.zone_no_guid: TTS did not give a GUID to the {role} discard zone I created: restart the bot once the table has settled.
err.prepare_reply: invalid answer to the table preparation: {got}
cfg.remove_table: remove_table: an object of GUID -> expected TTS object name (strings)
prep.removed: I removed {what} {guid} from the table (it was not needed).
prep.why.type: it is not the kind of object expected under that GUID
prep.why.place: it is outside the central table
prep.why.zone: it is a zone the bot uses
gate.status.ready: Table ready · set up heroes and map, then press [[panel.start]]
gate.issue.leftovers: loose objects of the previous game are left ({detail})
gate.issue.hand_cards: there are cards in the hands ({detail})
gate.issue.heroes_out: the deck, dials or pieces of {detail} are still in the bag
gate.issue.dials: dials are not at their starting value ({detail})
gate.issue.forms: the {detail} miniature is not in its starting form
gate.issue.tokens: tokens that do not show their starting face ({detail})
gate.issue.saved_game: the bot's saved game is still there (state/session.json)
gate.other_pair_reset: {bot} and {human} were on the table: I put their cards back in their decks and set their miniatures off the board, but their decks stay where they are. Put them in their bags and press the button again to prepare the table with Medusa and Hellboy.
cfg.prepare_map: prepare_map: board, bag and board_guid (text), position (x, y, z), rot_y and scale (0-10)
gate.issue.map_missing: there is no map on the table
gate.notice.no_map: There is no map on the table.
gate.notice.map_unplayable: The map on the table cannot be played: {error}
gate.notice.map_other: The map on the table is {name}, not B.P.R.D. HQ: I leave it as it is.
gate.map_failed: I could not take the map {guid} out of the bag {bag} ({why}).
gate.map_taken: I took the B.P.R.D. HQ map out of its bag ({bag}) and laid it in the middle of the table.
gate.unpack_error: The script that takes the heroes out of their bags failed: {error}
gate.unpack_problem: I could not take {hero}'s things out of their bag ({guids}): {why} By hand: open the {hero} bag (GUID {outer}), take out the inner bag {bag} and tip its contents onto the table; then press the button again.
gate.unpack_why.outer: the infinite bag is not on the table or has another name.
gate.unpack_why.listed: the infinite bag does not hold the inner bag.
gate.unpack_why.spawning: the inner bag was still spawning; wait a moment and press the button again (the copy it left is reused).
gate.unpack_why.none: its inner bag is not on the table and I could not take it out.
gate.batch_reply: TTS did not answer the table read as expected ({got})
gate.batch_failed: A step on the table failed ({name}): {error}
gate.start_refused: The table is not ready yet: I am not starting. Press the clean and prepare button first.
gate.deck_away: {name}'s deck is on the table but not at its spot
gate.not_read_yet: I have not read the map or the heroes yet: the table is not prepared.
gate.not_read: I could not read the table as it is: {error}
gate.notice.other_heroes: There are objects of other heroes on the table ({detail}): I leave them alone. If you will not use them, put them back in their bag.
gate.audit_failed: I could not check the table: {error}
gate.already_ready: The table is already ready for a new game: no leftovers, no cards in hands or discards, no miniatures on the board.
gate.dirty: The table is not ready for a new game: {issues}. Press [[panel.prep]] and I will leave it clean and prepared with Medusa and Hellboy.
gate.nothing_to_do: The table was already clean and prepared: nothing to do.
gate.cleaning: Cleaning the table and preparing it with {bot} (bot, green) and {human} (you, white)...
gate.cleaned: Table clean and prepared: {bot} and {human} face to face. Decks shuffled, dials full, miniatures off the board and hands not dealt.
gate.left_over: I cleaned what I could, but this is left: {issues}.
gate.clean_failed: I could not clean the table: {error}. You can press the button again or fix it by hand.
gate.next: Now set up the table with the heroes and the map you want to test and press [[panel.start]]. I will not start until you do.
gate.starting: Reading the heroes and the map from the table and starting the game.
gate.start_failed: I cannot start: {error}. Fix the table and press [[panel.start]] again.
